target.table_description: Business Data Product - branch-level lending performance metrics aggregated from loan accounts

columns.name: branch_name
columns.description: Branch display name from reference data

columns.name: total_loan_value
columns.description: Sum of active loan amounts for the branch

columns.name: active_loan_count
columns.description: Count of active loans for the branch

columns.name: avg_loan_amount
columns.description: Average loan amount across active loans

code.content:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

loans = spark.table("fdp_uk_lending_db.loan_account")
branches = spark.table("fdp_uk_branch_db.branch_ref")

result = (
    loans
    .filter(F.col("active") == "1")
    .join(branches, loans.branch_id == branches.branch_id, "left")
    .groupBy(branches.branch_id, branches.branch_name)
    .agg(
        F.sum("loan_amount").alias("total_loan_value"),
        F.count("loan_id").alias("active_loan_count"),
        F.avg("loan_amount").alias("avg_loan_amount")
    )
    .withColumn("reporting_date", F.current_date())
    .withColumn("dw_lod_tmp", F.current_timestamp())
)
